name: Know That I Loved You
source:
On dying soil beneath a punctured sky far in the future — two colleagues and old friends are stuck together out in a research station. Things take a turn when one of them collapses into a week-long, lethal coma; and another turn still when hours into having been presumed dead: Ivan wakes back up.

[From [url=https://snailiah.itch.io/know-that-i-loved-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在遥远的未来，在被刺穿的天空下垂死的土壤上——两个同事和老朋友被困在一个研究站里。当他们中的一个陷入长达一周的致命昏迷时，事情发生了转变。在被推定死亡数小时后，又发生了另一件事：伊万醒了过来。

[来自[url=https://snailiah.itch.io/know-that-i-loved-you]itch.io[/url]]
